title: MARGoS: A Configuration-Driven Platform for Reproducible MARL Experiments in ARGoS
abstract: arXiv:2610.13772v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has become a prominent research direction, particularly within collective robotics, where the ARGoS simulator is widely used to study emergent swarm behavior. Yet despite this growth, systematic support for reuse and reproducibility in MARL-based swarm robotics remains limited and insufficiently standardized: a single experiment is assembled from manually aligned simulator files, training scripts, configuration values, paths, seeds, and environment details, so reuse and reproduction stay fragile even within one research group. To address this gap, we introduce MARGoS, a lightweight, configuration-driven platform developed in this project that elevates these experiment-defining inputs to first-class, platform-managed artifacts. translated_title: MARGoS：一个基于配置驱动的ARGoS可复现多智能体强化学习实验平台
translated_abstract: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）已成为一个重要的研究方向，尤其是在集体机器人学领域，ARGoS模拟器被广泛用于研究群体智能的涌现行为。然而，尽管这一领域不断发展，基于MARL的群体机器人学在复用和可复现性方面的系统性支持仍然有限且缺乏标准化：一个实验往往由手动对齐的模拟器文件、训练脚本、配置值、路径、随机种子和环境细节拼凑而成，因此即使在同一个研究团队内部，复用和复现也依然十分脆弱。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MARGoS，这是一个在本项目中开发的轻量级、配置驱动的平台，它将上述定义实验的各种输入提升为由平台统一管理的一等公民工件。MARGoS通过配置哈希、端到端种子传播、冻结（不可变）配置、结构化日志、环境指纹（原文在此处截断）等机制实现可复现的实验。
tldr: MARGoS是一个轻量级配置驱动平台，通过配置哈希、端到端种子传播和不可变配置等机制，系统性地解决了基于MARL的ARGoS群体机器人实验中复用与可复现性不足的问题。
en_tdlr: MARGoS is a lightweight, configuration-driven platform that systematically addresses the lack of reuse and reproducibility in MARL-based ARGoS swarm robotics experiments through configuration hashing, end-to-end seed propagation, and immutable configurations.
